```{r}
library(lubridate)
Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "English")
meetups2627 = c(ymd("20261207"), ymd("20270111"), ymd("20270301"), 
                ymd("20270404"), ymd("20270503"), ymd("20270607"))

next_date = min(meetups2627[meetups2627 >= Sys.Date()])

```

Our next meetup will take place on **`r format(next_date, "%A, %B %d, %Y")`** at 6pm \
in Café Prückel \
Stubenring 24, 1010 Vienna
